label: economist at organization
definition: Person X works or worked as an economist for or affiliated with organization Y.
scope_notes: Includes: explicit economist at/for/with/of; historical departmental economist affiliation. Excludes: analyst/strategist/specialist/professor/executive alone; generic financial expertise. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear economist/employer attachment.
